text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Despite her frustration at losing the<n>spring Tenno
Sho, Mejiro Bright<n>vows to keep trying. Her
persistence<n>reminds Mejiro Dober of the racers
she looks up to.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober feels a pull to become<n>like Mejiro
Bright, but then she<n>realizes she's always been
focused<n>on becoming someone else.

Because she has no confidence in<n>herself, she's
been chasing after<n>others. But everyone she sees
as<n>shining was able to succeed because<n>they were
resolved to do things their<n>own way.

Having come to this conclusion,<n>Mejiro Dober
decides she must<n>confront her own weaknesses if
she<n>wants to forge a new Mejiro legacy.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her goal is no longer to become like<n>anyone else
but to become truly<n>strong as Mejiro Dober! Her
mind<n>made up, she begins preparing for the
Takarazuka Kinen.
